structured_output.title: Certificates with IP in commonName may change SAN output
structured_output.content: The environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests and the certificates.cert-manager.io [v1] CRD, so the change to how an IP address in `commonName` is handled could reach it. After the upgrade, such an IP would no longer appear in the DNS subjectAlternativeName list and would be placed in `ipAddresses` instead. The operator should inspect each Certificate manifest for an IP address in `spec.commonName`. They should also check whether anything consuming the issued certificates relied on that IP appearing as a DNS SAN. The environment summary does not show the Certificate specs, so whether any actually sets an IP in `commonName` is unknown.
